context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from LiquidAI/LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct (config.json max_position_embeddings 128000). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-30. A domain SFT (LoRA merged into the base) of LiquidAI/LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct, identical tensor set. Recorded because the card prints a base row and a this-model row in the same table - 95.2 vs 84.2 on overall rubric score. The evidence is the weakest kind in the catalog: a ~20-task DarkLab automated rubric, author-run, which the card itself labels directional and not an industry benchmark, and one category (dilution_round_structure) trails the base by 22.2 points. Confidence 0.5 reflects that. Not Apache-2.0: LFM Open License v1.0, ~$10M revenue threshold. Repo created 2026-09-18.
